locus_A: Fig 1 panel 'Lipid Nanoparticle Library Design', drawn text: 'Library of 1020 formulations'
locus_B: Abstract, Sec 1, Sec 3.1 and the SI all say 1080; the deposited design grid is 3 (N:P) x 5 (MC3:helper) x 4 ((IL+HL)%) x 3 (chol:PEG) x 6 (helpers) = 1080, equal to the deposited row count
resolution: 1020 is a figure typo. The factorial is PROVED to be 1080 (07_qc.json P6).

claim: Number of top formulations carried forward
locus_A: Sec 3.1: 'the top 32 formulations from each helper lipid type (186 LNPs in total)'
locus_B: SI Tables S1-S6 hold 6 x 32 = 192 rows, with 192 distinct LNP ids and 192 distinct compositions; 24 clusters x 8 = 192
resolution: 186 is wrong; the SI, the cluster arithmetic and the row count all give 192. Checked for duplicate compositions across the six tables: 192 unique.

claim: Which clusters were carried to i.v.
locus_A: Sec 3.2: 'Clusters AI, AIII, BIII, CI, CII, CIV, DI, DIII, and FIII performed with the highest efficiency'
locus_B: Fig 3B's x axis carries DI and DII (not DIII), and the NEXT sentence says 'three clusters - BIII, CIV, and DII - yielded low efficiency'
resolution: The text's 'DIII' is wrong; the figure and the following sentence agree on DII.

locus_A: Sec 3.3: 'AI-b3, CII-b2, CII-b3, DI-a1, DI-a3, and FIII-b3 all achieved transfection levels exceeding 5 x 10^4 photons/s'
locus_B: Our independent read of Fig 4B: those six ARE the six largest bars (6/6, separated from the seventh by a factor of 1.33), but DI-a3 reads 4.47e4 -- 10.6% below the stated threshold, about 13 px on a panel whose worst held-out tick residual is 0.48 px
resolution: OPEN as a discrepancy. The SET is exact; the THRESHOLD is not met by the sixth member. Not reconciled: 10.6% is far outside our error budget and we do not adjust a read to meet a sentence.

locus_A: Fig 1 labels the construct 'Ai9 dual gRNA'; Methods Sec 2.6 gives the strain as B6.Cg-Gt(ROSA)26Sor-tm9(CAG-tdTomato)Hze/J, which IS the Ai9 allele
locus_B: The prose calls it Ai14 eight times, and Ai14 is tm14, not tm9
resolution: The figure and the strain designation agree on Ai9; the prose name Ai14 is the outlier. Not resolvable from the paper. No corpus consequence: nothing is emitted.

locus_A: Fig 1 draws the polyether bracket with subscript 44
locus_B: One further ethyleneoxy unit is drawn OUTSIDE the bracket before the methyl cap, so the DRAWN total is 45; the corpus DMG-PEG2000 string carries exactly 45
resolution: RETIRED, and in the reassuring direction. The subscript alone would be a 44 Da error that only an InChIKey catches; the corpus agrees with the DRAWING, not with the subscript. Verified by zooming the bracket at 5x native.

locus_A: SI Tables S1-S6 header: 'transfection efficiency in HepG2 cells (measured in RLU)'
locus_B: The values run 1.705-9.233 and are numerically identical to the ln(RLU) column RLU_HepG2 in the Mao lab's own deposit for PMID 39375194
resolution: The header is wrong: these are ln(RLU), not RLU. A column header is a claim, not a measurement.

locus_A: Sec 3.2: 'DOTAP-based cluster AI-V reached a maximum bioluminescent flux of 1 x 10^6 photons/s'
locus_B: Helper A has clusters I-IV only (Fig 3A, SI Table S1); Fig 3A's tallest A bar is A-IV at ~1e6
resolution: 'AI-V' is a typo for A-IV. Fig 3A's A-IV bar is the one at 1e6.

locus_A: Sec 3.2: 'despite having a negative charge in their helper lipid structure, DOPE, DSPC, and 18PG exhibited comparable levels of transfection'
locus_B: Fig 1's own Helper Lipid box classifies DSPC and DOPE as '+/-' (zwitterionic) and only 18PG and 14PA as '-'; Sec 3.1 itself says 'anionic helper lipids 14PA and 18PG'
resolution: The sentence contradicts the paper's own figure and its own earlier sentence. DOPE and DSPC are zwitterionic.

locus_A: SI captions for Figs S3, S4, S5 and S6 call it 'CII-3' / 'LNP CII-3'
locus_B: The main text calls it CII-b3 throughout; Fig 4C labels the DOTAP lead 'A1-b3' where Fig 4A writes 'A1a'/'A1b' and the SI tables use roman 'AI-'
resolution: Cosmetic. Roman I and digit 1 are used interchangeably for the same cluster, and the sub-cluster letter is dropped in four SI captions. Recorded because it is exactly the kind of label drift that makes a substring join wrong (02_corpus_overlap.json token test: 'A1' matches 5,249 corpus rows and 4,393 distinct structures).

locus_A: Sec 3.4 contains 'We further quantified tdTomato expression in the liver using FACS analysis and observed around 16.9% of all cells in the liver displayed positive tdTomato signal' TWICE, verbatim and consecutively
resolution: Editorial. Noted so a reader counting sentences does not treat it as two measurements.
